name: Diffuse Dissolve
description: The first clip diffuses into a shimmering, grainy haze, as if its pixels were scattered further and further from where they belong, and the second clip condenses back out of the haze as they settle into place. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: radius
params.description: How far the pixels scatter at the peak, in frame heights

params.name: grain_size
params.description: Size of a grain, in frame heights

params.name: shimmer
params.description: How much the grains swirl around while they are scattered
